description:
About our brand and products:
Testament Collection is an independent luxury fragrance house built around story, memory and emotional identity. Our fragrances are extrait de parfum creations designed to be worn, collected and remembered. Each perfume is developed as a chapter, with its own atmosphere, cultural references and emotional tension. The collection includes bestselling creations such as Sang Noir, Karma, Exotic Leather, Brown Sugar, Cosmology and Tea on a Cruise, offering distinctive profiles across amber, leather, gourmand, floral, woody, smoky and spicy territories.

What makes us different:
Testament is not built around generic fragrance marketing or one single hero product. We focus on collection depth, repeat customer behaviour and fragrances that carry a strong point of view. Our perfumes are created for people who want more than a pleasant smell; they want identity, memory and character on skin. We produce selectively, work with controlled batches and place strong importance on storytelling, dry-down performance, customer experience and long-term brand trust.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates can earn by sharing their personal tracking link and introducing new customers to Testament Collection through content, reviews, recommendations, social posts, videos, stories, blogs, newsletters or community channels. When customers purchase through an affiliate link, the affiliate receives commission based on eligible sales. The program is designed for creators, fragrance lovers, collectors, reviewers and lifestyle voices who can communicate the brand authentically and help people discover fragrances that match their personality and taste.

How to promote us:
Affiliates can promote Testament by creating honest fragrance reviews, discovery-set recommendations, seasonal edits, “which perfume should you wear” content, unboxing videos, daily scent routines, gifting guides and personal storytelling around the fragrances. We encourage content that explains how each scent feels on skin, how it develops over time and what type of person or mood it suits. Strong content should focus on emotion, identity, dry-down, performance, storytelling and why the customer may want to return to the fragrance.

Other information:
Testament Collection is best promoted through authentic, personal and story-led content rather than generic sales language. We value creators who understand fragrance as an emotional product and who can explain why a perfume matters beyond notes alone. Affiliates should use accurate brand information, avoid misleading claims and represent the products with care. Campaign updates, new launches, private sales and seasonal promotions may be shared with active affiliates to support content creation and improve conversion.
